MOMENT_TO_EVIDENCE_KIND, HUMAN_STATUSES=={unconfirmed,confirmed,corrected,disputed,annotated}, _split_audio_if_needed fast-path), (b) POST /api/sessions/{sid}/voice multipart with duration_sec/location — response returns rec_* id, 64-char sha256 content_hash, transcription_status=pending, moments_status=pending, voice_memo_event_id=evt_*, rightprint_identities_present is a list, (c) voice_memo_recorded evidence event emitted IMMEDIATELY at upload (sensitivity=creative, payload.sha256==content_hash, event_id==voice_memo_event_id), (d) polling GET /api/voice/{rid} — within ~15s transcription_status=done with non-empty transcript+segments+language=en, moments_status=done with detected_moments[] each having mom_* id + kind in MOMENT_KINDS + confidence 0-1 + human_status=unconfirmed + all human_* fields null + detected_at, (e) guardrail — pre-review snapshot inside fixture proves NO voice-derived chord_progression_changed event exists before any human review, (f) confirm harmony_idea → propagated_event_kind=chord_progression_changed, downstream event has sensitivity=creative, payload.source=voice_evidence, payload.recording_id + payload.moment_id populated, parent_event_id==voice_memo_event_id, (g) dispute rights/split → human_status=disputed, human_note persisted, NO new rights_discussion event with matching secure_reference.moment_id, (h) final_approval confirm → approval_signed emitted with sensitivity=sensitive, secure_reference.collection=voice_evidence + moment_id, raw excerpt NOT present in stored payload (json.dumps search), (i) review 400 on unknown action + 404 on unknown moment_id, (j) list sorted newest-first, add speaker persists, reclassify preserves reviewed moments + no duplicate (kind, excerpt), (k) access control — freshly-registered stranger user gets 403 on /api/voice/{rid} and /api/voice/{rid}/audio. Regression: /app/backend/tests/test_cei_v2.py (26) + /app/backend/tests/test_auto_doc_v2_1.py (16) all still pass — combined suite 61 passed, 2 skipped in 48s. FRONTEND (chromium via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): logged in with test@songright.com, navigated to /sessions/sess_96285667fb26/studio, WRITE → Evolution — evolution-voice-btn visible; clicking it opens data-testid='voice-booth' with hero copy 'Every voice belongs to the record.', voice-location + voice-speaker-input + voice-start-btn all present; view-live opens VoiceEvidencePanel with 'VOICE EVIDENCE LAYER' header + voice-booth-open button; panel populated with 15 voice-record-* cards + 181 moment-* cards from prior test runs; Live stream shows voice-derived events including 'Voice-derived · final approval' as APPROVAL SIGNED with HASH-ONLY lock badge (sensitive redaction confirmed visually) and 'Voice-derived · harmony idea' as CHORD PROGRESSION CHANGED (creative, full excerpt).
critical_code_review_comments: media_evidence.promote_moment_to_evidence: after emitting a downstream event, the moment dict is updated with propagated_event_kind ONLY inside the local list; however the review response returns this in-memory dict — good. But for DISPUTED/ANNOTATED reviews, propagated_event_kind is never set, so downstream consumers must key on human_status, not merely the presence of propagated_event_kind. Consider also stamping propagated_event_kind=None explicitly on dispute/annotate for symmetry.

server.py upload_voice_recording writes the raw audio to /tmp/inheira_voice_{recording_id}.{ext} but never deletes it after process_recording finishes. Over long runtimes /tmp will fill. Add a finally: os.remove(tmp_path) inside process_recording or a background sweep.

media_evidence._transcribe_whisper reads the full chunk into memory via `with open(chunk_path,'rb') as f: await stt.transcribe(file=f,...)` and _classify_moments truncates seg_map at 400 segments — for a 60-min recording with many short segments this can silently drop context. Consider streaming-safe segment sampling.

Reclassify de-dupe key is (kind, excerpt.strip()) — if Claude returns the same excerpt with a trailing period on the re-run it will be treated as different. Normalise (kind, excerpt.strip().rstrip('.,;').lower()) for robustness.

Added /app/backend/tests/conftest.py to guarantee /app/backend is on sys.path — previous iterations relied on invocation-cwd. Without this, `import evidence` / `import media_evidence` inside tests raises ModuleNotFoundError depending on how pytest is invoked.

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19 executed, 2 skipped due to short-transcript moment scarcity; 61/61 across full backend suite when counting regression)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded several voice recordings against sess_96285667fb26 (espeak-ng-generated 40KB mp3s of the exact spec phrase). Ledger accumulated ~15 voice records + associated evidence events; append-only design tolerates repeat runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice Evidence Layer is fully green. Test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_voice_evidence_v2_2.py. Two tests skip when the short spec phrase produces only 3 detected moments (harmony_idea, split/rights_discussion, final_approval) and earlier review tests consume them all — annotate + correct then have nothing unconfirmed left. To achieve 21/21 without skips, use a longer spec transcript with 5+ detectable moments, or upload TWO separate recordings (one dedicated to annotate/correct). All 4 review actions (confirm, correct, dispute, annotate) are individually covered functionally; only the residual coverage is skipped. Sensitive events are verified NOT to include raw excerpts in `payload` (only secure_reference carries moment_id + collection). For future media-agnostic work (video/screen/DAW/MIDI/camera), the same schema+guardrails from media_evidence.py apply — parameterise media_kind in tests. Also note: I added /app/backend/tests/conftest.py to ensure sys.path — do not remove it or `import evidence` will regress.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no product bugs found. Two test-infra fixes applied: (1) guardrail assertion had to be captured inside the shared `transcribed` fixture BEFORE any pytest-xdist worker could schedule review-flow tests earlier in the same worker; (2) sensitive-event query originally checked `payload.moment_id`, but evidence.record_event strips payloads for sensitive kinds — corrected to query secure_reference.moment_id. Both fixes are test-code only; no server behaviour changed.
